attempts.notes: TCP to mapped public port 22067 refused during banner exchange; SSH daemon may not be accepting connections.
Local ed25519 public key is not accepted by RunPod proxy for this account/pod.

required_prerequisites: In RunPod Console → User Settings → SSH Public Keys, paste the contents of the local id_ed25519.pub (full line starting with ssh-ed25519).
In the Pod Connect tab, copy the exact Basic SSH command (format often podId-userId@ssh.runpod.io) and ensure it works from this machine.
For SCP/file transfer: ensure SSH over exposed TCP works (sshd running in the official PyTorch template) using the Connect tab 'SSH over exposed TCP' command.
Optionally open the Pod Web Terminal once and confirm ~/.ssh/authorized_keys contains the same public key.
Do not paste private keys or API keys into chat.
reason_not_terminated: Qualification incomplete; pod was manually deployed by user; safe stop leaves it running.
